claim: Sample demo changes stay separate from an existing archive in browser storage.
where: landing action, demo banner, and demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with a pre-seeded real archive sentinel; edit, reset, exit, and assert only demo storage changes

claim: The demo opens with six checked sample bookmarks covering the review results.
where: demo entry point and demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert six sample records and every listed result state

claim: Imported archives and edits stay in extension local storage without a hosted request.
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:extension-local-storage
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1; choose Exit demo, import HTML, edit a note, and assert chrome.storage.local contains the archive with no non-extension request

claim: This site loads no analytics, advertising scripts, or third-party fonts.
sandbox: fresh browser context starting at /demo; visit every public site route and assert every runtime request is same-origin

claim: Dead pages, restricted pages, moved or changed links, and failed checks stay separate.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; select each listed review group and assert its distinct result and reason

claim: Link checks start only when you ask.
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:explicit-checks
sandbox: fresh packaged extension demo at options.html?demo=1; import a controlled saved URL, observe no request while idle, then click Check visible links

test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:html-import
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1; import a Netscape bookmark fixture; assert visible title, folder, timestamp, record count, and demo-only storage

claim: Finds duplicate URLs after removing common tracking parameters.
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:duplicate-detection
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1; import a UTM URL and clean variant; open Duplicates and assert one visible duplicate

test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:url-repair
sandbox: fresh packaged extension demo at options.html?demo=1; import a bookmark, repair its URL, reload, inspect chrome.storage.local, and export HTML

claim: Keeps review decisions and omits archived bookmarks from export.
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:decision-persistence
sandbox: fresh packaged extension demo at options.html?demo=1; set keep, review, and archive decisions, reload, inspect storage, and export HTML

claim: Shows each bookmark's saved year, link result, duplicate status, and note.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; inspect the sample ledger and duplicate group for each visible field

test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:credential-free-checks
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1 with a browser cookie; check a local fixture URL and assert the server received no Cookie header

claim: The checker spaces requests apart and honors Retry-After limits.
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:request-spacing
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1; check local fixture URLs; assert same-host arrival spacing and that a Retry-After response blocks the next same-host request

claim: Standard HTML export is always free.
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:html-export
sandbox: fresh unlicensed packaged extension demo at options.html?demo=1; seed 51 kept records with an exhausted check limit, export, and assert every record is in standard HTML

claim: An $18 one-time license removes the 50-check limit.
where: paid tier, extension license panel, terms, and README
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:paid-license
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1 with 51 invalid-URL fixtures; exhaust 50 attempts, prove a retry cannot bypass the cap, mock a valid license verification, and assert every visible record can be checked again

claim: A license check sends only the license token to Sociobot.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with a private archive sentinel; capture the mocked Sociobot request and assert GET, the exact verify path, only the license query parameter, no body, and no archive data

claim: No purchase link is shown while checkout is unavailable.
where: paid tier, extension license panel, README, privacy, and terms
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo, then navigate home; assert the paused notice is visible and no checkout link is present
